title: Rock, punk and what is called jazz or music today
summary: Edison complains that black youth are drawn from jazz and that rock performers trade on bodies, not music, and he calls jazz culture comparable to Mozart.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
